summary: Frontend-only tests for CendekiaLMS iteration: (1) Tutor certificate management on /profile — upload PDF added item, upload 1x1 PNG added item, oversized (~3MB) PNG was rejected client-side, .txt was rejected client-side; remove buttons deleted each cert and 'certificates-empty' returned. Qualifications & CV cards still present (regression OK). (2) Student dashboard /student shows 'student-recommendations' card with focus 'Matematika · Literasi', lists 4 exercises (ex_utbk_1 → /student/courses/course_utbk/learn, to_1/to_2/to_3 → /student/tryouts) and 1 course (course_math → /student/courses). (3) Admin /admin/analysis shows 'recommendations-section' with 7 rec-student cards including Ahmad Fauzi with Matematika/Literasi exercises + course chips. All regression summary cards, subject-bars, weakness-highlight, and 3 CSV download buttons present. (4) Proctor /proctor/weakness shows 'recommendations-section' with 5 rec-student cards; recap restricted to school 'SMA Nusantara 1' only. Certificate cleanup performed — tutor certificates array back to empty.
critical_code_review_comments: Profile.js: onCertChange/removeCert rely on server-returned array; already handled with fallback — OK.
StudentRecommendations.jsx exLink correctly points exercises linked to a course to /student/courses/{course_id}/learn and TryOuts to /student/tryouts.
WeaknessReportView.jsx section only renders if any student has recommendations — good UX safeguard.

Observation (non-blocking): tutor@lms.id has 4 qualifications currently (Matematika, Fisika, Kimia, Informatika). Review request expected 3 — likely pre-existing state from a prior iteration, not modified by this run.
